hooks.command: bash -c 'cmd="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "rm -rf|DROP TABLE"; then echo "{\"decision\": \"block\", \"reason\": \"危険なコマンドはブロックされています\"}" && exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *.ts || "$file" == *.tsx ]]; then result=$(npx oxlint "$file" 2>&1); if [ -n "$result" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"additionalContext\": \"Lint errors:\\n$result\"}}"; fi; fi'
bash -c 'if [ -z "$STOP_HOOK_ACTIVE" ]; then export STOP_HOOK_ACTIVE=1; result=$(npm test 2>&1 | tail -20); echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"additionalContext\": \"Test result:\\n$result\"}}"; fi'
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Codeが入力待ちです" with title "Claude Code"' 2>/dev/null || true
